title: Zeta private deployment — weekly sync prep & action list
content:
Weekly sync prep notes — Customer Zeta (VPC + on-prem)
Date: 2026-03-11 (prep for 03/12 weekly cadence)
Owner: Chiara Mendes (SE) — internal notes / scratchpad
Collaborators: Omar (infra), Evelyn (SRE)

Purpose:
- Prep for weekly status call with Zeta eng and infra leads. Align on milestones, surface blockers, confirm owners and short-term mitigations.
- Capture follow-ups I need to send after sync.

Expected attendees (confirm before meeting):
- Zeta: Maya Singh (cloud infra), Tomas Li (platform), Sarah Kent (security)
- Redwood: Chiara (SE), Omar (infra eng), Evelyn (SRE), Alex (AM) — Alex may join first 10 min

Agenda (30 min)
- 5m: quick run through current milestone map (what’s green/yellow/red)
- 10m: deep-dive on two active blockers (network routing + HSM certs)
- 5m: rollout readiness checklist & smoke test plan for pilot region (on-prem DC-2)
- 5m: schedule follow-ups and ownership confirmation
- 5m: parking lot / Qs

Milestones snapshot (state + quick notes):
- Network peering & egress rules (Target: 2026-03-18) — status: yellow.
  - ZETA-341: NAT gateway throughput surprising; Maya trying ephemeral ports. Need final shared routes from Zeta infra (action: Tomas to share by 03/14).
- On-prem infra provisioning (Target: 2026-03-22) — status: green.
  - Chef/Ansible playbooks mostly ready; Omar validated storage perf on identical hardware.
- KMS/HSM integration & certs (Target: 2026-03-20) — status: red.
  - HSM vendor requires additional attestation steps; Zeta security wants co-signed cert. Evelyn to propose temporary KMS fallback for pilot by 03/15.
- Pilot rollout (Target: 2026-03-25) — status: tentative, depends on HSM and network.

Blockers & risks (to raise explicitly)
1) HSM attestation delay — impact: blocks secrets access for model keys, blocks E2E smoke tests. Mitigation: temporary KMS path + strict audit trail; risk of extra compliance review. (Owner: Evelyn, due 03/15)
2) Unexpected NAT/egress behavior for model telemetry — impact: telemetry and metrics ingestion may fail in pilot. Need final iptables/routing snippet from Zeta. (Owner: Tomas, due 03/14)
3) On-prem node time drift — observed on staging; if not resolved, KV cache invalidation leads to incoherent sessions. Add NTP check to preflight. (Owner: Omar, due 03/13)

Questions to ask Zeta during sync
- Can you confirm the maintenance window for DC-2 next week (03/18-03/20)? We need a 2 hour window for the kernel patch + restart.
- Has security signed off on temporary KMS fallback in writing, or do we need a signed waiver?
- Are there any capacity constraints on their internal load balancer that would affect scaling beyond 4 nodes?

Immediate follow-ups I need to do post-call
- Email recap + action table (send within 2 hours) — include owners, due dates, ticket links.
- Create a minimal runbook snippet for KMS fallback (Evelyn to review) and attach to Confluence (due 03/13).
- Patch our preflight checklist to add NTP and kernel cfg checks (Omar to PR by 03/13).
- Ping vendor contact for HSM attestation timeline and escalate if no update by EOD 03/13 (Chiara).

Action items (short, copyable)
- Tomas: share final VPC route table + iptables sample -> due 2026-03-14 -> linked to ZETA-341.
- Evelyn: draft KMS fallback runbook + audit steps -> due 2026-03-15 -> review with Zeta security.
- Omar: add NTP & kernel config checks to preflight + open PR -> due 2026-03-13 -> PR: github.com/redwood-inference/zeta-deploy/pull/78.
- Chiara: email meeting recap & chase vendor if no HSM update by EOD 03/13 -> due 2026-03-12 EOD.
- Alex (AM): confirm pilot test users and acceptance criteria for smoke tests -> due 2026-03-14.

Notes / context bits to mention live
- Performance testing on staging showed 95th p95 token latency ~ 420ms with current batch config; we recommended smaller batch window for DC-2 to hit 300ms SLO during pilot.
- Remind them that Dedicated routing fallback is configured — if on-prem fails we can switch a small percentage to hosted to preserve UX while we debug. Need to confirm capacity reservation.

Parking lot (not timeboxed unless requested)
- Longer-term: verify audit log shipping to Zeta SIEM (SPLUNK/Graylog) — projected for next sprint.
- Proposal: Post-pilot review checklist (ops->security->product) — draft after pilot.

My prep TODOs before call (today):
- Re-read ZETA-402 (HSM integration ticket) and extract exact attestation asks (30m)
- Confirm Alex availability for first 10 minutes (5m)
- Pull p95/p99 perf graphs from staging for last 7 days (Omar can help) (20m)

Tone notes: keep call pragmatic, call out "must have" vs "nice to have" clearly, insist on owner + due date on any blocker.

End of notes.

(If this is helpful, convert into the short email template after the call: 1) what happened 2) owners & dues 3) next meeting time)
